name: – Bogdan Andrzej Zdrojewski – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on temporary trade-liberalisation measures applicable to Armenian products
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a plan to let Armenian products into the European Union market with fewer trade barriers for a limited time. The aim is to support Armenia and its people. The lower trade barriers would last two years and come with conditions. If Armenia breaks them, the benefits can be paused. The European Union can also act if a sudden jump in imports disturbs its own market. Parliament accepts the European Commission's proposal without changes.

- Armenian goods get easier access to the European Union market for two years, under conditions.
- Armenian exporters and European Union farmers and businesses that compete with them.
- Parliament has approved its position; the Council must now agree for it to become law.
